excerpt.zh: 真是太棒了。我们的帝国终于摆脱了自然进化的束缚，一定可以在宇宙中大展宏图了。
excerpt.en: Commendable. With the yoke of natural evolution lifted from their shoulders, our people are sure to thrive in space.
